newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers recover while Med shuffles lower.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers recover while Med shuffles lower.

text.p: ARA bunker prices recovered some of their lost ground on Thursday afternoon, while Mediterranean prices shuffled a little lower in line with Wednesday's market crash.

Rotterdam 380 cst picked up from initial deals at around $114 fob in the morning to around $117 by late afternoon, around $3 up on Wednesday, reflecting gains in the barge market. One deal was as high as $118.50 fob.
Demand was reasonable without being spectacular and a number of shipowners continued to delay their decisions in expectation of further weakness before the year end.
Hamburg prices were $1 a tonne lower. A number of enquiries emerged, but resulted in few actual deals.
Mediterranean bunkers headed down further, fuel oil in Spanish ports by $2.
However, after a flurry of trades on Wednesday, most shipowners were uninterested.
Public offices in the port of Piraeus were closed, becalming any possible activity.
